title: Farmers' Alliance
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_A

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Ambush the Banned Uber Farmer on Level 5 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: QuestGiver_A

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Farmers' Alliance

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Ambush the Banned Uber Farmer on Level 5 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

The time has come for us to strike before iVan and his minions have a chance to gold more farms. We know that he has sent some of his most powerful Banned Farmers, Banned Uber Farmers, to turn the farm crops to gold on Level 5 of Ratsputin's Gulag.

Head into Level 5 of Ratsputin's Gulag and stop the Banned Uber Farmer before he can cause more trouble for us. I have talked to some of the farmers that have been put out of a job since their farms have been turned into gold and they are willing to help. They are actually hiding around the farm and will help you to ambush the Banned Uber Farmer once you are there. When the Banned Uber Farmer has been vanquished return to me, Yakov Smearnov, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

You have done well, but iVan will continue to send his Banned Uber Farmers until they prevail. Let me know when you are ready to head out again.

Objectives:

  • Slay the Banned Uber Farmer on Level 5

Client level range: 85–100
